title: Feature-gated traffic shift — internal announce + Q&A (notes)
content:
Purpose: quick internal announce and Q&A scaffold for the staged traffic shift to the 'latency-optim' model variant behind a feature gate. This is my working notes — rough, intentionally choppy.

Audience: ENG (serving/runtime, infra, sres), Product ops, CS triage leads, Support L2, Growth (for feature-flag targeting), Execs (brief line). Tailor messaging for each group.

High-level ask: we will enable the new model variant (quantized, smaller KV footprint) behind a feature flag for 10% of host-api requests starting Fri 10/11 18:00 PT. Goal: validate latency improvements and error mode behavior at scale while keeping ability to rollback to stable model within 2 minutes.

What I want to land in the short announce (one-paragraph):
- Why: expected median p50 token latency improvement ~12–18% on p3/gh200 families for common seq lengths (64–256). Also expected token-cost reduction ~8% with negligible quality regression for short-respone queries.
- When: Fri 10/11 18:00 PT, ramp to 10% over 30m.
- Who: monitored by infra SRE and the release owner (Asha).
- Rollback: instant toggle, fallback to stable routing if error rate >1% or latency tail > +40% vs baseline for 5m.

Quick Q&A (draft responses):
Q: How are we defining success?
A: Primary: no regression in end-to-end error rate (API 5xx + model errors) and <10% increase in p99 latency. Secondary: token-cost per request reduction and stability of output (sampled prompts show no hallucination spike on our eval set).

Q: Will this affect enterprise/tiered customers?
A: Not initially. Feature gate excludes dedicated and private deployments; flag applied only to hosted-api free-tier & standard routes. Enterprise customer tokens are pinned to stable model variants.

Q: Who can flip the flag?
A: Asha (release owner) + SRE on-call (primary) + me as fallback. We will use the feature-control service (audit logs enabled).

Q: What monitoring is in place?
A: Dashboard: latency by route/model-variant, error-rate by route, model-quality sampling (prompt subset), alerting: page on 5xx increase >0.5pp or p99 increase >30% sustained 5m. Synthetic golden prompts hit every 2m. Logs: correlation ids for sampled traces.

Q: How do we communicate rollback to customers?
A: No customer-facing change planned. If we rollback due to regressions, ops will send a short post-mortem to #ops-notices and customer-success if any customers were impacted.

Talking points for SRE/infra sync (bullet list for standup):
- Preflight checklist: kernel flags, inference node pool autoscale policies reviewed, canary sample size validated, golden prompt runbook ready.
- Resource check: ensure at least 2 spare p3/gh200 nodes in pool for rollouts.
- KV cache warm-up: schedule pre-warm of top 1000 prefixes for the 2h window prior to shift.
- Emergency rollback procedure: feature-control toggle + routing table restore + drain in-flight tokens to avoid partial outputs.

Open/unknowns (notes to self):
- Need exact query set for the "golden prompts" — coordinate with Applied ML (Benji) to ensure it captures long-tail failure modes.
- Confirm cost accounting tag will surface on billing exports (so finance can see delta for the experiment).
- Double-check that the feature-flag audit includes actor, timestamp, reason, and pre/post-state.
- Validate that hosted-api quota enforcement won't inadvertently block partial rollouts (some customers have route-specific rate limits).

Draft Slack announce copy (short):
"Heads-up: Fri 10/11 18:00 PT we’ll enable the latency-optim model variant behind a feature flag for 10% of hosted-api traffic (30m ramp). Goal: validate p50/p90 improvements and stability. Monitored by infra SRE + Asha. Rollback criteria set; will post updates in #ops-notices. Ping me or Asha for concerns"

Extended internal email / standup note (longer):
- One-paragraph summary (what/why/when) + link to playbook + who to call for rollback.
- Include the preflight checklist and quick runbook steps (attach Confluence playbook link).

Post-launch follow-ups (what I want to collect):
- 1h: sanity check p50/p90 and errors on targeted routes.
- 4h: sampling of outputs for quality review (Benji).
- 24h: cost delta and aggregate error/latency metrics + decision: keep ramping to 25% or roll back.

Fallback language for execs (one-liner):
"Running a limited, monitored test of a latency-optim model variant to validate production performance. No expected customer-visible changes; rollback is immediate if any stability signals show up"

Tasks before send (todo list):
- [ ] Finalize golden prompt set (Benji).
- [ ] Confirm billing tag (Luis).
- [ ] Dry-run toggle with SRE staging (Asha + SRE).
- [ ] Draft Slack + Standup lines and get a quick +1 from Product leadership.

Notes to self (tone/style):
- Keep public-facing lines minimal and low-risk. Avoid technical caveats in initial announce; route those into a follow-up runbook for ENG.
- Make sure CS triage gets an FAQ snippet (3 bullets) so they can answer common questions quickly.

Recent edits / context:
- 10/02: initial idea after bench-run improvements on 64-token median.
- 10/03: added rollback thresholds after SRE feedback.
- 10/04: tightened ramp window to 30m and added cost-tag ask.

Questions I need help closing (assignments):
- Benji: final golden prompts by 10/07.
- Luis: confirm billing tag + finance contact by 10/08.
- Asha: schedule staging dry-run 10/09.

If anyone reads — feedback welcome. If you want to be on the notify list DM me and I'll add you to the release watchlist.
